blenheimchalcot-blenheimchalcot:greenhou.description: Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter. Trusted by leading brands across three continents, including Gymshark , Huel and Oh Polly, Fospha manages $4 billion in annual ad spend. We're scaling fast across London, Mumbai, and Austin – and we're now looking for Talent to join us across our Customer Success Teams. The Role Driving onboarding speed and quality — you'll be the person making sure clients get value fast, and get it right Managing post-go-live implementation requests for our enterprise and growth clients, configuring changes to their live systems Querying our database - learning SQL to query Client’s data and solve problems (no previous experience required!). Getting hands-on with the product — assessing, configuring, and troubleshooting client account setups using your growing technical knowledge Spotting risk early — flagging anything that could threaten adoption or renewal before it becomes a problem Building real relationships — you'll be on client calls regularly, and confident, clear communication will become second nature Working cross-functionally — partnering with Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing Science and Product and your wider team to keep everyone aligned on onboarding progress Using AI to work smarter — we actively want you experimenting with our Gen AI tools to find better, faster ways of working In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency The Centre of Excellence The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Teams, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles: Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with their skills and interests Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes What we're looking for Curious and proactive — you ask "why" and go find the answer A STEM or Economics graduate (or equivalent analytical background) Motivated by solving problems methodically, not just ticking boxes A confident communicator, both written and verbal Interest in learning SQL Someone who builds trust

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4e13c902-bc8b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in France. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Requirements: Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5e2e17d7-a8d6-.title: Centralized Scheduling Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5e2e17d7-a8d6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Centralized Scheduling Coordinator based in the United States. The Centralized Scheduling Coordinator will manage the scheduling and coordination of installation and service resources across a nationwide operation. This role serves as a key link between project management, customer support, subcontractors, technicians, and other field resources. You will assess project requirements, match qualified resources to assignments, and build efficient schedules based on availability, location, skills, and customer needs. The position combines relationship management, logistics, problem-solving, and operational coordination in a fast-paced environment. Success requires strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining service quality. You will also contribute to process improvements that make scheduling more efficient and strengthen the customer experience. This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity with a consistent Monday–Friday schedule and meaningful responsibility for keeping field operations running smoothly. Serve as a primary point of contact for subcontractors and business partners, providing guidance, feedback, installation requirements, and technical information to support high-quality service delivery. Review installation and service statements of work to identify appropriate approved contractors and available technicians for each assignment. Coordinate closely with Project Management to understand project requirements, resource needs, timelines, and scheduling priorities. Partner with Customer Support to ensure service requests and dispatches are scheduled promptly and accurately. Plan and schedule installation and service jobs based on project requirements, customer preferences, technician capabilities, geographic location, and resource availability. Coordinate field technicians and installation teams to allocate resources efficiently and minimize scheduling conflicts or delays. Source internal and external labor resources as needed to fulfill installation and service requests. Negotiate and create purchase order numbers to secure assigned labor resources for installation and service work. Provide technicians and business partners with detailed installation guides and relevant job information to support successful execution. Coordinate material logistics by arranging shipment of required parts from assigned warehouses to appropriate locations. Track projects through completion, ensuring jobs are posted, updated, and closed accurately and on time. Identify scheduling challenges, adjust priorities as needed, and proactively resolve issues that could affect project timelines or customer satisfaction. Contribute ideas and recommendations to improve scheduling processes, resource utilization, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience. Requirements: Previous experience in scheduling, dispatch, workforce coordination, field operations, logistics, or a related environment, with intermediate-level scheduling experience preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and credibly with a wide range of stakeholders. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities, with proven capacity to manage multiple schedules, projects, requests, and deadlines simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt quickly when priorities, resource availability, or customer requirements change. Ability to build positive working relationships with subcontractors, technicians, project managers, customer support teams, and other internal and external partners. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality, and timely completion of work. Self-motivated and capable of working independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team
